businesses.business: packaged nutritious snacks and meal replacements

offering_description.value: Develops and markets branded nutrition bars, shakes, snacks and sweet treats for health-conscious consumers. Products are made by contract manufacturers and sold mainly through grocery, mass, club, e-commerce and convenience channels.

primary_products.value: protein bars; ready-to-drink protein shakes; snacks; cookies and sweet treats

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery, mass merchants, club stores, convenience and e-commerce retailers; B2C: health-conscious consumers following low-carb, protein-focused or balanced diets

end_markets.value: packaged foods; nutritional snacking; health and wellness; meal replacement

revenue_model.value: product sales: packaged bars, shakes and snacks sold to retailers and online

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets branded nutrition products made by co-manufacturers, sold to retailers and consumers

geography_served.value: North America: United States primarily, plus Canada and some international markets

specialization.value: related lines: nutrition bars, shakes, snacks and sweet treats sharing consumers and retail channels

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: grocery, mass merchandise, club, convenience, drug and natural stores; online: Amazon and brand direct-to-consumer websites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety, labeling and marketing rules from FDA, USDA and FTC
